**Group:** Detritus  ·  **Optics:** high-mag, low-mag

## Defining characteristics

A non-living aggregate of detritus: an irregular, often fluffy, cluster of debris. Outlines are diffuse and variable, with translucent gaps between components. Key features: irregular loose floc, diffuse edges, heterogeneous mixed contents.

## Distinguishing from similar classes

| Similar class | How to tell them apart |
|---|---|
| **fecal_pellet_long** | Fecal pellets are compact, defined ovoid or cylindrical particles; aggregates are loose, irregular with diffuse edges. |
| **dense** | The Dense class is for solid, opaque, tightly packed masses; aggregates are loose and translucent with visible gaps. |
